description: Na₃In₂Li₃F₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic Ia̅3d space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.46 Å) and four longer (2.59 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Li is bonded to four equivalent F atoms to form LiF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent InF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. All Li-F bond lengths are 1.89 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₄ tetrahedra. All In-F bond lengths are 2.11 Å. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one In atom.
